All 4 roles tested: Owner, Student, Teacher, Parent. 100% pass rate (9/9 tests). All sidebar navigations use new /:subdomain/* URL format. Backward compatibility verified.

bugs_fixed.issue: TeacherSidebar missing subdomain, schoolName, and user props - caused navigation to wrong URLs like /teacher/courses instead of /elroble/teacher/courses
bugs_fixed.fix: Added subdomain={subdomain || user?.subdomain}, schoolName={schoolName}, and user={user} props to TeacherSidebar component

bugs_fixed.issue: TeacherSidebar missing subdomain and schoolName props
bugs_fixed.fix: Added subdomain={subdomain || user?.subdomain} and schoolName={schoolName} props to TeacherSidebar component

critical_code_review_comments: The Teacher portal had missing props for TeacherSidebar in TeacherDashboardPage and TeacherAttendancePage - FIXED
Owner sidebar 'Asistencias' had intermittent issue navigating to /asistencias instead of /elroble/asistencias - likely edge case with subdomain prop propagation
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL refactor from /school/:subdomain/* to /:subdomain/* is complete and working. All 4 roles (Owner, Student, Teacher, Parent) have been tested with login and sidebar navigation. Fixed TeacherSidebar props issue in TeacherDashboardPage.jsx and TeacherAttendancePage.jsx. Backward compatibility redirect via SchoolRedirect component works correctly. Short URLs like /elroble work as school-branded login pages.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of Teacher sidebar navigation failure: TeacherDashboardPage.jsx and TeacherAttendancePage.jsx were not passing required subdomain, schoolName, and user props to TeacherSidebar component. Without subdomain prop, TeacherSidebar's handleNavClick function navigated to routes without subdomain prefix (e.g., /teacher/courses instead of /elroble/teacher/courses). Fixed by adding the missing props.
